description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Voice service in PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and contains method annotations for various operations supported by the service, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: ChimeSDKVoiceClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Chime SDK Voice service, providing methods to interact with the service API.

methods.name: associatePhoneNumbersWithVoiceConnector
methods.description: Associates phone numbers with a voice connector.

methods.name: associatePhoneNumbersWithVoiceConnectorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates phone numbers with a voice connector.
